# Blender export dependency

`GLTFExporter.js`, `TextureUtils.js` and LICENSE from Three.js tag r160
(source behavior unchanged; trailing whitespace normalized):
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160/examples/jsm

`gltf-exporter.offline.js` wraps the two modules in a factory taking the existing
Three.js instance. Generated by `node scripts/build-blender-exporter.cjs`.
It does not load a second engine or access the network. No build is needed to run Furnish.
